theme: An open Halloween Saturday with the girls.
greeting: The calendar's empty, Dan — Halloween in St. Pete with the four girls and nothing scheduled before tomorrow's Sunday review. The one thing worth touching today is the board's backlog so Mike's 9 AM review has less to chew on.

needsAttention.title: Mike's 15-minute Sunday review at 9 AM
needsAttention.detail: The recurring board review is tomorrow morning, and its own rule kills anything that's slipped three Sundays running. The two items most likely to get axed are the Christmas rental and the December trip, so come ready to decide them.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The only six-seater drives south this month, so Christmas in Maine needs a rental. A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland over the holidays is the thinnest inventory of the year. P1 on the board, overdue since mid-September.

needsAttention.title: December break destinations
needsAttention.detail: Both the shortlist and the book-by dates have passed; six people over three weeks across the holidays is the hardest inventory to find late. P2 on the board.
